main_text.p: Regnat, honoratos anteque Vertit anuos. (Hunc patria, hunc Musis, hunc religionis honori, Hunc serua[?] Imperio, Christe benigne, Ducem,) Hic ergo Aonidum cultissima turba Dearum Lata nouo tecum federat hospitio: Iamque sacrum feruebat opus: iam plurima pubes Huc ab Hyperboreis venerat usque plagis: Ipsa domi studijs et acumine Gallia diues Venerat, et magni nobilitate Duces: Tum tibi, Vix actis aui melioribus annis, Praecipitant miseram fata seuera necem, Florentemque ipsa messem populantur in herba: Sic breuis heu quantum subruit hora decus! Vt cum luxurians culmis Vredine[?], vel cum Verbere depastus grandinis, aret ager: Aut si fulgentem nocturno in fornice rimis, Admissa exilis deleat aura facem. O vanas hominum spes! o vanumque laborem! Quo vix, si qua venit, gloria parta venit. Quid meritis niti virtutis ad ardua tantis Culmina, quid summo vertice stare iuuat? Occupet extremum scabies, et inutile vulgus, Si nihil est doctas excoluisse Deas. Seu quis amet crudas Busyridis impius aras: Iuratamue colat cum pietate fidem: Iustus Aristides, Lapithaque, Ixionidesque Ad Stygias vna puppe feruntur aquas. Fallor? an infestis perflantur ut ardua ventis, Leuius exiles impetit aura casas: Optima sic hominum properata morte petuntur: Intactaque subit fex scelerata vices? Sternitur ante alios Troum fortissimus Hector: Infami Danaus miles ab hoste cadit. Mille fouet pestes sub cardine mundus utroque: Nec minor est furiis et fuga digna cohors, Quos cruce, quos radiisque rota, si iustus habetur Iuppiter, aut cur non Parca repente necat? Nil timet, illicitas exercens sordibus artes, Qui miseris nullam praestat auarus opem: Utque homines iugulent, surgentes nocte latrones, Aut quos ex rapto nutris adunca manus:

page.notes: Verse printed continuously; stanza breaks are not clear enough to separate, so the whole poem is one block with line breaks kept. Line 2–3 "serua[?]" is doubtful (the word may read "ferua" or "seruata"). "Vredine[?]" is doubtful. "scelerata" contains a Cyrillic-looking letter in the source copy: the word is Latin "scelerata" and should be checked; it is kept as printed. Line 1 "anuos" is kept as printed with vowel u. Line 14 and 36 spacing may differ from the scan. No marginal notes on this page.
